title: VtoT formatting test document
purpose: Each line states the formatting it is supposed to have. Apply that formatting with the slash command (or the equivalent voice command), save the document as .html, and the checker verifies every line really carries what its text claims. Doubles as a practice sheet for a new user learning the commands.
scope: Full-line / block commands and whole-line inline styles, including clearing a style. Selection-based and right-click behavior is a separate document.
source_of_truth: slash keys from DictationEditor.COMMANDS; html signatures from editor.to_html (semantic tags, vtot-* classes for screenplay elements)

lines.voice: make this a heading three, then body text
lines.text: Make this line Heading 3, then make it body text.
lines.note: two steps on purpose: it shows how body text clears a block style, and body text is the default look
